description: This is a unit test class for the FeaturePropertiesModified class, testing its immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, exception handling, and resource path generation.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that FeaturePropertiesModified instances are immutable, also asserting that FeatureProperties is immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correct implementation of hashCode() and equals() methods for FeaturePropertiesModified.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Ensures that creating an instance with a null ThingId string throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Ensures that creating an instance with a null ThingId object throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeatureId
methods.description: Checks that passing null for featureId raises NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullProperties
methods.description: Checks that passing null for properties raises NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toJson() method produces the expected JSON output.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating a FeaturePropertiesModified instance from valid JSON.

methods.name: createInstanceFromJsonWithNullFeatureProperties
methods.description: Tests handling of null feature properties when parsing JSON.

methods.name: getResourcePathReturnsExpected
methods.description: Ensures getResourcePath() returns the correct JsonPointer based on feature ID.
